body:
The `_wp_primary_selection_source_on_send()` function lacks handling for this MIME type.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/60fff00a660a2aeb03f88c07fb7baed353bcb72f/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp#L2944-L2946

Perhaps it should be added there.

Oops I wanted to wait for this review comment to be resolved but I forgot to remove the PR from my upcoming batch.

CC @deralmas

Oh that's tricky! Took me a minute to figure out.

Yea, that's an usual case of the primary selection code being out of sync with the main one. You can simply copy paste the logic from the regular clipboard handler:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/60fff00a660a2aeb03f88c07fb7baed353bcb72f/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp#L2610-L2620

We could perhaps wrap this part in a method but I'm somewhat skeptic that it would stop cases like these in the future.
(Yea right this got merged, making a PR rn xD)

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e3dc665263bba9d76977ee6aa4d0c2a5758c6f4c/platform/linuxbsd/wayland/wayland_thread.cpp#L5586

`primary_get_mime()` also returned incorrect data. It should be `ss->primary_data`.
